column2: Match the approved Endless Buffet paint-overs in Card Game Art / Paintovers (PAINTOVER-BUFFET-*) and the quality of PAINTOVER-TOWN.png. All of these show regions of ONE main zone (there are no separate sub-areas). Endless Buffet look: indulgent, warm, absurdly delicious; warm dinner-time evening with candle and oven glow and soft steam. Palette: cream #F4D8B0, tomato #E07A5F, golden crust #C98B3A, icing pink #F6B8C4, herb green #6B8E3D, chocolate brown #7A4A2A. Cake and pastry buildings, oven-brick kitchens, copper domes, tablecloth awnings. PAINTED, not pixel art: clean bold shapes, soft cel-shaded painting. No text or letters anywhere.
Seamless, tileable, hand-painted texture viewed perfectly straight-on (orthographic). Flat, even, neutral lighting. Evenly distributed detail; edges match so it tiles. Square 1024x1024.

A single hand-painted object or detail, viewed straight-on (or from the low game camera for props), centered, fully transparent background (PNG). Soft painted shading, no cast shadow outside the object, crisp edges. Slightly oversized storybook proportions.

6 related items on ONE transparent image in a 3x2 grid, each centered in its cell with wide clear empty gaps (nothing touching), same scale and lighting, viewed straight-on. Claude slices them apart. 2048x1365 (or 1536x1024).

A single hand-painted tree or plant seen from a low camera slightly above (about 25 degrees down), rounded storybook shapes, warm light from the upper left, base at the bottom center, fully transparent background, no ground or cast shadow. 1024x1536.

Concept: the landmark alone in a three-quarter view from the low game camera, plain flat light background, clear silhouette, a 1.7 m person beside it for scale. Backdrop: a wide distant-scenery layer along the bottom with a transparent sky above, atmospheric haze; left and right edges match if noted.

Save to Card Game Art / Pending Review; approved files go to Card Game Art / Approved_ZoneKits / Buffet. Reused from earlier batches (don't remake): TEX-BUFF-MASHED, -FROSTING, -BISCUIT, -CHEESE, -GRAVY, -CRUMBSOIL, DEC-CRUMBS, DEC-SAUCE, and the shared ENV-* kit.

column5: Image Description (paste STYLE TARGET + the Lock first)

The main-dungeon goal: an enormous gleaming industrial kitchen-laboratory complex (castle-sized) with copper domes, towering chimney stacks venting colorful steam, giant whisk and ladle cranes, glass greenhouses, and the half-built silhouette of a food war machine peeking over its walls. Beautiful on the outside but faintly sinister. Must read from across the zone as THE place to go.
